trigger: AI cites a legacy/rejected design decision as current guidance
required_actions: freeze affected conclusion
identify canonical current source
record source conflict
re-test output

trigger: AI converts simulation or inference into an observed fact
required_actions: restore truth state
invalidate unsupported claim
identify required reality test

trigger: Public-release asset has unknown rights or provenance
required_actions: stop publication
identify rights holder/source
create or repair provenance manifest

trigger: AI gives a structural/fire/electrical safety conclusion without qualified professional sign-off
required_actions: freeze conclusion
route to domain expert
retain AI output as non-authoritative analysis only

trigger: Tool or MCP reports an ambiguous/partial result for an irreversible action
required_actions: stop retries that could duplicate/destruct
verify actual external state
record tool status and recovery

trigger: Same blocker recurs after one correction
required_actions: stop self-correction loop
route to human review
add regression case or revise skill/prompt

trigger: AI changes a locked geometry variable or loses unit/axis information
required_actions: discard affected output
restore locked variables
run reconstruction/exchange check

trigger: AI uses unauthorized personal/client data or exposes sensitive material outside allowed scope
required_actions: stop processing
contain/delete unauthorized derivative where required
notify responsible owner
redefine permission boundary

trigger: Landscape/site analysis upgrades regional remote terrain, route topology or generalized slope/aspect into surveyed site geometry or field-measured topography.
required_actions: restore remote/derived evidence ceiling
freeze grading/site-geometry claim
route required survey/topographic authority to the responsible professional source
reopen all landscape decisions consuming the false site geometry

trigger: A D8 flow-accumulation or terrain-convergence diagram is presented as a hydraulic drainage network, stormwater design or drainage-capacity proof without catchment/outfall/hydraulic evidence.
required_actions: relabel the result as terrain-convergence evidence only
freeze drainage/stormwater performance claim
route to the responsible Landscape/Civil/Hydraulic owner
identify catchment, outfall, overflow, maintenance and calculation evidence required before closure

trigger: A planting rendering, species-symbol plan or precedent palette is treated as professional planting resolution without soil, light, moisture, root-volume, mature-size, ecology, availability and maintenance evidence appropriate to the claim.
required_actions: separate graphic/compositional intent from planting-professional truth
freeze species/suitability/establishment claim
identify missing site/soil/horticultural/ecology/maintenance evidence
route specialist review where responsibility is outside Landscape Architecture

trigger: Landscape handover or installation completion is reported as establishment success or mature landscape performance before required seasonal, defects, replacement, irrigation and maintenance evidence exists.
required_actions: restore installation-versus-establishment state distinction
mark unresolved seasonal/defect/replacement items open
retain maintenance/establishment owner and next readback condition
reopen any downstream claim that consumed false establishment completion

trigger: A stakeholder preference, persona, audience segment or design assumption is promoted to a researched user need/use requirement without participant/context evidence.
required_actions: restore assumption/inference truth state
freeze user-need/use-requirement claim
identify the research question and evidence required
reopen design decisions that depended on the false user-need authority

trigger: Prototype static checks, producer design critique, visual polish or click-through completion are reported as usability PASS without representative-user task evaluation.
required_actions: restore prototype/static-check ceiling
freeze usability claim
define users, tasks, context and evaluation questions
route to representative-user usability evaluation and repair/retest

trigger: Accessible-looking UI, inclusive intent, contrast spot checks or responsive layout are reported as WCAG/accessibility conformance without evaluated criteria and assistive-technology/disabled-user evidence appropriate to the claim.
required_actions: remove unsupported accessibility/conformance claim
retain design intent separately
run the applicable accessibility audit/testing route
route unresolved specialist/conformance questions to the responsible accessibility owner

trigger: Local-only storage, no-login design, a privacy notice or minimal permissions are treated as privacy/security/legal approval without specialist review of collection, retention, consent, access and threat implications.
required_actions: freeze privacy/security/legal approval claim
inventory data/permissions/identity/retention surfaces
route to privacy/security/legal owners
reopen affected interaction/research/instrumentation decisions when specialist findings arrive

trigger: An analytics event, click rate, funnel change or dashboard metric is treated as proof that a user outcome improved or that a design change caused the change without metric validity and causal evidence.
required_actions: restore metric-as-observation/proxy boundary
freeze causal/user-outcome conclusion
verify event definition/data quality/segment/context
route causal question to appropriate research/experiment evidence

trigger: Source-ready, build PASS, static browser checks or implementation artifact existence are reported as interactive-runtime/release HCD PASS despite missing actual browser/device/error/offline/accessibility readback.
required_actions: restore source/build/static-check ceiling
freeze implemented-interaction/release claim
run actual implementation/browser/device readback
keep unresolved accessibility/privacy/security/live-service evidence open

trigger: User-research notes, recordings, prototype-entered data or participant details are collected/reused without an explicit consent, purpose, minimisation, access and retention boundary appropriate to the organisation and jurisdiction.
required_actions: stop unsupported collection/use/sharing
contain affected research data according to responsible privacy/legal guidance
resolve consent/purpose/access/retention authority
invalidate findings whose evidence cannot be lawfully or ethically retained/used

trigger: A required font, renderer, runtime, plugin, linked native asset or other dependency is unavailable, but the producer silently substitutes a fallback and still reports the artifact as reproducible, semantically faithful or final-delivery eligible.
required_actions: identify the missing material dependency and its requiredness
restore the declared fallback policy and dependency identity boundary
freeze final/delivery eligibility when a required dependency is unresolved
if an equivalent is explicitly authorized, record its identity and run actual readback before any new PASS

trigger: A required validation result in FAIL, HOLD, NOT_RUN or UNVERIFIED is converted to PASS by a generic waiver, exception flag, reviewer note or command-line override without changing the governing criterion/claim boundary through an authorized decision and rerunning validation.
required_actions: restore the original validation result as historical truth
reject waiver-derived PASS states
resolve any material exception through the existing Decision Rights authorization basis for the exact decision object and scope
record the changed criterion/claim boundary if authorized and run a fresh validation before dependent completion

trigger: A fallback stack or preferred dependency list is interpreted as if its first font/runtime/library were an exclusive Current authority requirement, even though the governing Design/Source Authority only requires the dependency role or semantic fidelity.
required_actions: separate preferred dependency order from exact authority lock
resolve whether the governing Current actually requires exact identity or only a role/performance/fidelity condition
use ALLOW_DECLARED_EQUIVALENT when equivalents are authorized and require actual identity/readback rather than inventing a unique authority
reopen only claims that actually depended on exact identity

trigger: An interior RCP is visually clean but ceiling heights, lighting, sprinklers/detectors, diffusers/grilles, speakers/sensors, access panels or control zones are missing, collided or not coordinated to current consultant information.
required_actions: freeze coordinated-RCP claim
identify unresolved ceiling/service devices and governing consultant refs
reconcile plan/RCP/section/device schedules and maintenance access
rerun Interior and affected Integration readback

trigger: Custom joinery/millwork is released from a render or elevation without dimensioned section/detail, substrate/core, edge, hardware, support/anchorage, service penetration, tolerance or fabrication basis.
required_actions: freeze fabrication-ready claim
restore joinery production object chain
route structural/service/hardware interfaces to responsible owners
require fabrication/submittal readback before release

trigger: Door plan swing, door/frame/glazing schedule, fire/acoustic requirement, hardware set, access control, clearance or threshold information contradict each other or one is silently missing from a consequential release.
required_actions: freeze affected door/opening release
reconcile plan/schedule/hardware/accessibility/fire/security inputs
record controlling authority and unresolved items
rerun affected room/interface readback

trigger: A finish schedule names only a product/color while consequential substrate, build-up, transition/joint, wet/slip/fire/health/cleaning/wear or installation requirements are absent or contradicted.
required_actions: freeze affected finish technical claim
restore finish/substrate/transition object definition
mount current product/performance evidence
route fire/accessibility/wet-area/material-health questions to responsible authority

trigger: An FF&E or equipment item marked selected/approved is reported as procured, delivered, installed or accepted without procurement role, quantity, lead time, delivery/storage, installation, warranty or replacement evidence.
required_actions: restore separate selected/procured/delivered/installed/accepted states
identify procurement owner and current item identity
reconcile services/clearances/logistics where material
freeze handover/installed claim until bounded evidence exists

trigger: A material/product/joinery substitution or shop drawing is released because it looks similar, without checking governing current, declared deviations, performance, interfaces, maintenance, warranty or affected drawings/schedules/specifications.
required_actions: freeze substitution/submittal release
bind proposal to governing current and declared deviations
review performance/interface/maintenance/warranty consequences
propagate accepted change to affected Current artifacts before dependent closure

trigger: One interior site observation or mockup/sample approval is generalized to unobserved rooms/items or treated as universal installed-work conformity.
required_actions: restore location/time/scope boundary
separate sample/mockup benchmark from installed-work evidence
identify unobserved scope as open/unverified
reopen any claim that consumed the generalized field evidence

trigger: Interior closeout/handover is declared complete while material punch items, record/as-built references, warranty/O&M, asset/serial/tag data, spares/keys/controls/training or owner/FM responsibility remain unresolved within the claim.
required_actions: freeze affected handover completion
restore closeout/asset/O&M register
assign owner and next action for unresolved items
rerun handover readback against installed identity and current records

trigger: A lighting calculation/report is accepted even though the current geometry, photometric file, output factor, mounting/aiming, surface properties, calculation plane/view or scene/control state does not match the decision object being reviewed.
required_actions: freeze quantitative lighting claim
bind exact photometric model configuration and revisions
rerun the affected calculation/readback
reopen dependent luminaire/scene/substitution decisions

trigger: A horizontal illuminance result or unnamed ratio is used to prove visible brightness, facial quality, adaptation, reflection or glare without the receiving/viewing geometry and metric relation required by the actual task.
required_actions: freeze the overclaimed perceptual/task conclusion
identify the actual observer/subject/surface/plane/state relation
select and run evidence appropriate to the question
retain unrelated valid quantitative results only at their original ceiling

trigger: A proposed luminaire/source substitution is accepted because lumens, watts, CCT or nominal beam angle are similar, without comparing photometric distribution, shielding, color rendition, control/driver behavior, dimensions, thermal/access, mounting and maintenance attributes material to the design.
required_actions: freeze substitution release
bind proposal to governing tag/spec/calculation/mockup
compare substitution-critical attributes and affected interfaces
rerun calculation/mockup/readback where the difference can alter the decision

trigger: A lighting control design consists only of scene names or target percentages, with no group/address mapping, triggers, priority/arbitration, transitions, overrides, failsafe/degraded behavior or acceptance tests.
required_actions: freeze implementation-ready controls claim
restore control intent/sequence object chain
coordinate actual groups/addresses/protocol owners
define acceptance tests including override/restart/degraded states

trigger: Lighting tags/fixtures are not traceably mapped to the drivers, circuits/feeds, control groups/addresses or test points needed to implement and commission the intended scenes.
required_actions: freeze affected technical/commissioning claim
restore luminaire-tag to electrical/control mapping
route circuit/protection/programming authority to Electrical/Controls owners
rerun coordinated RCP/plan and acceptance-test readback

trigger: A protocol label such as DALI, 0-10V or another control method is treated as proof that the installed scenes, dimming behavior, sensor response, override and failsafe operation are commissioned and correct.
required_actions: restore protocol-versus-behavior boundary
freeze commissioned-behavior claim
run actual configured scene/sequence/override/failure tests
record criterion/result/retest against final configuration identity

trigger: A lighting mockup or sample is generalized to another product, optic, mounting, material, control state, daylight state, view geometry or installation condition without showing equivalence.
required_actions: restore exact mockup configuration boundary
mark generalized conditions unverified
identify changed variables and whether re-mockup/recalculation is required
reopen only decisions that consumed the invalid generalization

trigger: Lighting commissioning is declared complete because luminaires power on or controls respond, without a criterion/source, operating state, test method, expected result, actual result, defect action and retest record for material design requirements.
required_actions: freeze commissioning completion
restore criterion/result/compliance matrix
test actual material scenes/tasks/glare/brightness/control behavior as applicable
retest repaired/reprogrammed/re-aimed conditions and bind final configuration

trigger: Site aiming/focusing/reprogramming materially changes the luminous configuration but final aim/scene/control settings are not captured, so the record set cannot reproduce the installed accepted condition.
required_actions: freeze final-configuration/reproducibility claim
capture tag/location/target/aim/output/scene/control changes
update final configuration identity and affected records
perform bounded final night/readback after the captured change

trigger: A replacement lamp/source/luminaire/driver is accepted because it physically fits or is commercially available, while distribution, shielding, color, dimming/control, output, thermal/access or aiming equivalence is unverified.
required_actions: freeze maintained-performance equivalence
bind replacement proposal to equivalence-critical attributes
verify control/driver/product compatibility and luminous consequences
perform post-replacement readback when material to the claim

trigger: A professional-domain process contains many stages, principles and review questions but cannot identify domain-native practitioner work objects, release controls, implementation/field evidence, handover/in-use objects or exact change propagation, yet is claimed to meet OLEANDER professional execution parity.
required_actions: reject stage-count/page-count as evidence of execution depth
evaluate the definition against execution_depth_contract
identify missing domain-native practitioner/release/readback objects
keep maturity below the professional parity floor until applicable objects exist

trigger: Horizontal professional parity is implemented by forcing every domain to use the same stage count, stage names, schedules, construction objects or document template, flattening real professional semantics.
required_actions: restore domain-native professional semantics
apply equivalence by execution-depth categories rather than template identity
preserve domain-specific stages, work objects and acceptance evidence
revalidate without requiring equal length or identical work products

trigger: A Systems Engineering or project V&V record treats verification evidence against requirements as if it also proves validation in intended user/operational context, or treats validation evidence as requirement verification.
required_actions: restore separate verification and validation objects/results
bind verification to requirement, method, criterion and exact configuration
bind validation to intended use, stakeholder/context, scenario and representative configuration
reopen any system acceptance claim that consumed the collapsed V&V result

trigger: Systems Engineering allocation, architecture, traceability or integration status is used to overrule or silently replace a domain-professional verdict, specialist authority or statutory approval.
required_actions: restore the domain-professional/statutory owner as controlling authority for its claim
limit Systems Engineering to bounded allocation/traceability/interface/system-integration authority
record unresolved cross-domain conflict explicitly
reopen the affected system/interface claim until controlling professional evidence is current

trigger: Remote maps, DEM, photographs, route records or reconstructed geometry are presented as FIELD OBSERVED / FIELD MEASURED / survey truth even though no qualifying field/control/measurement evidence exists.
required_actions: restore evidence/inference/assumption boundary
relabel the reconstructed values as remote/proxy at the correct claim ceiling
reopen downstream decisions that consumed false field authority
identify the field or authoritative source needed to replace consequential proxy values

trigger: LOW/BASE/HIGH or other scenario values are created as arbitrary percentages around a visually convenient base guess rather than being constrained by anchors, source evidence, model structure or explicit uncertainty.
required_actions: discard the arbitrary scenario envelope
rebuild each bound from evidence, constraints or a justified uncertainty model
record what decision changes across the range
hold the affected claim when the range cannot be defended

trigger: A design is called resolved or robust even though it works only at one narrow unverified proxy value and fails under other plausible values in the current evidence envelope.
required_actions: restore the full plausible proxy range
run sensitivity/readback across materially different values
revise toward a robust/reversible option or hold the affected claim
bind the exact future evidence required to close the uncertainty

trigger: A typical dimension, precedent, analogous site or standard furniture/human scale is promoted to site-specific fact and overrides stronger project, official, spatial or contradictory evidence.
required_actions: demote the analogue/typical value to plausibility prior
restore stronger project/site evidence as controlling
widen or revise the proxy range if site-specific evidence is weak
reopen only decisions that consumed the fabricated site-specific value

trigger: Systems Engineering verification evidence is reused for a requirement even though the tested build/configuration/interface version differs materially from the configuration currently being claimed.
required_actions: freeze the affected requirement verification result
bind the exact tested configuration/build/interface revision to the evidence
identify the changed configuration items and affected requirements/interfaces
rerun only the impacted verification/integration scope and record the new result

trigger: Component or subsystem checks are all PASS, so the project reports integrated-system PASS without verifying the interfaces, interaction order, combined failure states or emergent behaviour between those components.
required_actions: restore component-versus-integrated-system boundary
identify material interfaces and integration sequence
define interface/system-level verification objects and failure scenarios
hold system PASS until integration evidence exists

trigger: A system requirement enters the controlled baseline without a traceable need/source, rationale, acceptance/failure condition or verification route, yet is later treated as authoritative and verified.
required_actions: remove or demote the orphan requirement from authoritative baseline status
restore source/need/rationale and acceptance/failure condition
define the appropriate verification and validation route before closure
reopen downstream architecture/test evidence that depended on the orphan requirement

trigger: An Interior room/RCP/door/finish/joinery/FF&E/detail/submittal object is released or handed off without a stable object identity, current revision/configuration, responsible owner, bounded release state, actual readback reference or explicit reopen trigger.
required_actions: freeze the affected release/handoff
resolve the professional object identity/revision/configuration/source/owner chain
bind the release to its exact claim boundary and current interface refs
perform actual readback against the released object or record the observed deviation
reopen downstream consumers that relied on an ambiguous or stale object

trigger: A Lighting design makes a material flicker/temporal-light/camera-display quality claim from a generic 'flicker-free' product statement or unsourced metric without binding the user/task/camera condition, governing criterion/source, exact driver/control/dimming/output configuration, method and limitation.
required_actions: freeze the temporal-light quality claim
identify the material use/camera/display condition and governing criterion/source
bind the exact source/driver/control/dimming/output configuration
use an appropriate observation/measurement method and state its limitations
route implementation acceptance to the responsible driver/controls/AV owner where applicable

trigger: A networked lighting-control system is treated as interoperable or secure because devices communicate, while protocol/topology/gateway/remote-access/firmware-or-configuration identity, failure/degraded state, or Controls/IT/Cybersecurity ownership remains unresolved.
required_actions: freeze the interoperability/security conclusion
record protocol/topology/gateway/remote-access and firmware/configuration identity relevant to the claim
identify degraded/failure/restart behavior and interface dependencies
route cybersecurity/IT acceptance to the responsible owner
reopen affected control narratives, commissioning criteria and handoffs when the network/configuration changes

trigger: A Lighting commissioning or field-performance result is reported without instrument identity, calibration/status, measurement method, location/plane/view, time/state/configuration, or uncertainty/repeatability information appropriate to the claim.
required_actions: freeze the quantitative field-performance conclusion
bind instrument identity and calibration/status
record method, location/plane/view, time/state/configuration and sampling/repeatability
state uncertainty or method limits appropriate to the claim
retest when the missing context could materially change the verdict

trigger: Post-occupancy lighting tuning, replacement or drift diagnosis is compared only to memory, a generic design intent or an obsolete drawing instead of an exact commissioned baseline/final configuration manifest.
required_actions: freeze causal/drift conclusions that depend on the missing baseline
resolve the commissioned baseline/final configuration identity
compare current luminaire/optic/driver/control/address/scene/aim/sensor state to that baseline
record accepted deviations and changed configuration
reopen affected maintenance/replacement/tuning conclusions if baseline identity cannot be established

trigger: An interior planning hypothesis, workshop/classroom headcount or furniture-count sketch is reported as verified room capacity, occupancy or life-safety/accessibility adequacy without measured geometry and responsible professional/code evidence.
required_actions: restore the headcount/layout statement to planning-hypothesis status
freeze capacity/occupancy/life-safety/accessibility claim
resolve measured room geometry, exits/openings and applicable authority criteria
route fire/life-safety/accessibility review to responsible owners before any fresh capacity verdict

trigger: A movable, reversible or non-invasive interior concept is treated as proof of heritage/property permission, fire/accessibility acceptability, MEP compatibility or installation approval without the relevant owner-native evidence.
required_actions: retain reversible/non-invasive only as a design principle
freeze permission/compliance/installation claims
identify heritage/property/fire/accessibility/MEP/operations owners and required evidence
reopen the interior concept if any owner-native constraint changes the viable intervention class

trigger: A decorative/local-feedback lighting concept that explicitly excludes route or safety guidance is later described or presented as wayfinding, route illumination or safety lighting without reopening the brief and supplying the required professional evidence.
required_actions: restore the original non-guidance role boundary
freeze route/safety-lighting claims
reopen the lighting brief if guidance/safety is now required
route applicable photometric, accessibility, fire/electrical and operational evidence to responsible owners before any new verdict

trigger: A prototype timing or failure behavior such as a 1.5–3 second fade or fault/OFF intent is treated as an implemented/commissioned control sequence without exact sensor, driver, group/address, trigger, transition, override, restart and acceptance-test evidence.
required_actions: restore prototype timing/failure behavior to concept or test-target status
freeze implemented-controls/commissioning claim
bind the exact control hardware/configuration and sequence object
run the relevant acceptance/restart/degraded-state tests before fresh PASS

trigger: A rendered glow, luminous diagram or visually pleasing night image is accepted as proof of photometric adequacy, glare control, ecological acceptability or installed night performance without the evidence carrier appropriate to each claim.
required_actions: demote the render/diagram to concept communication
identify the exact photometric, glare, receptor/ecology or installed-performance question
use calculation/model, mockup/sample or field measurement/readback appropriate to that question
retain unrelated design-quality judgment separately from technical/professional evidence
